data.narrative:
Skyryse is a Series C aerospace company currently valued at $1.15B post-money, having raised over $500M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a peer set of 5 private companies in the Space & Aerospace sector at similar or adjacent stages, spanning valuations from $1.3B to $8.0B, alongside reference to 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 27.4x price-to-sales.

Two methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $1.1B, implying $2.0B at the next financing stage. Peer-median analysis across the five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies yields a $2.0B median valuation, with the peer range spanning $1.3B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable given the absence of disclosed revenue for the target. The stage-progression and peer-median methods converge on identical point estimates of $2.0B.

Triangulation across these two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $1.7B (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $2.0B. This implies 47–100% upside from the current $1.15B valuation. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations (particularly Sierra Space's $8.0B outlier), the absence of revenue-based comparables for public anchoring, and typical early-stage execution risk.
